skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK Direct DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 5000% ATK [Specialized Direct DMG] with 5 consecutive strikes to all enemies. Negates 45% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrates [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Increases Crit Rate by 30% for 1 round. If ATK is higher than the target, 130% chance to reduce the target's Specialized-HP damage reduction by 2% for 4 rounds. Ultimate DMG 5000% > 7000% ATK; [Specialized Evasion] negation 45% > 60%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. When there are 2 or fewer targets, [Specialized Direct DMG] increases by 30%.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 30% [Suppression DMG Reduction]. Allies with [Suppression DMG Reduction] and Genos gain 30% [Suppression DMG Increase]. — [Suppression DMG Reduction]: reduces DMG received by 30%; when ATK is higher than the attacker, reduces by 150%. [Suppression DMG Increase]: increases DMG dealt by 30%; when ATK is higher than the target, increases by 150%.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: [Suppression DMG Reduction] 30% > 40% (when ATK is higher than the attacker, 150% > 170%). [Suppression DMG Increase] 30% > 40% (when ATK is higher than the target, 150% > 170%).

effects.desc: The defensive effect reduces damage taken (30–40%), increasing to a 150–170% reduction when the bearer's ST is higher than the attacker's.
Attack buff gives 30-40% mana and increases damage, increasing by 150-170% when the bearer's Attack is higher than the target.
